title: Pack 26 disjoint circles in a unit square, maximizing the sum of their radii
statement: Place 26 disjoint circles (touching allowed) inside the unit square [0,1]^2 so that the sum of their radii is as large as possible. Submit {"centers": [[x, y]] * 26, "radii": [r] * 26}.

source.name: AlphaEvolve repository of problems (Google DeepMind)
source.cite: Mathematical exploration and discovery at scale, arXiv:2511.02864 (2025)
